reason: B offers a non-trivial extension by combining nitriding with debris-trapping laser texture and includes a nitrided-only control that can test synergy, whereas A largely repeats the exact treatment and outcome already demonstrated in E1. B is weakened by underspecified texture parameters and an ill-chosen falsification requirement that texturing raise hardness 1.5× over nitriding alone, but it remains the more novel and informative proposal.
